id: title:georgemunyoro:match like patterns in linear time

review.posthog_relevance: Protects HogQL query planning and dashboard rendering from CPU exhaustion caused by ReDoS (Regular Expression Dependency on Super-linear) attacks or pathological wildcard patterns.
review.reason: The change replaces a regex-based pattern matching implementation with a bounded, linear-scan implementation and adds a regression test. This demonstrates a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvement. The replacement of regex with a linear-scan matcher directly addresses the risk of ReDoS, which could cause CPU exhaustion and service degradation during HogQL query
review.uncertainty: While the implementation and test are visible, the actual runtime behavior and complete absence of ReDoS vulnerabilities in all edge cases are not independently verified by this patch alone; the benefit relies on the correctness of the new implementation and the effectiveness of the test.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a timing import and a performance regression test.
observations.code_quote: self.assertLess(elapsed, 2.0, f"like_matches took {elapsed:.2f}s — wildcard matching is not linear")
observations.posthog_connection: Checks that HogQL's pattern matcher does not enter ReDoS (Regular Expression Dependency on Super-linear) when processing patterns with many wildcards, protecting HogQL query planning and dashboard rendering from CPU exhaustion.

observations.behavior: Replaces regex-based pattern matching with a custom linear-scan implementation.
observations.posthog_connection: Implements a bounded, O(len(pattern) * len(text)) wildcard matcher in HogQL's pattern matching utility, replacing a regex translation that could cause ReDoS and CPU hangs during query parsing or result interpretation.
